title: Microplastic Pollution Remediation: A Comprehensive Review on Electrochemical Advanced Oxidation Processes (EAOPs) for Degradation in Wastewater
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00691K, Critical Review
ThaeSong Rim, Yi Xing, MyongJin Kang, Weiping Li, Yixiang Chen, Duo Zhang, Wenxin Li, Ying Guo, Xiangwei Zhang, Shanqing Wang, Zhongshan Qian, Wei Su, Bo Jiang
This review paper aims to provide a comprehensive overview of electrochemical advanced oxidation processes (EAOPs) for the removal of underwater microplastics. First, we analyze the sources of various microplastic contaminants...
